parts.gloss: beforehand / anticipating that which is to come

words.gloss: beforehand / anticipating that which is to come

literal: For those with wisdom who guard against that which is to come beforehand, there is not any affliction that comes to make them tremble.
translation: For those possessing the wisdom to guard against future events beforehand, there is no calamity that can come to make them tremble.
modern: வரப்போகும் துன்பத்தை முன்னதாகவே அறிந்து காத்துக் கொள்ளும் அறிவுடையவர்களுக்கு, அவர்கள் நடுங்கும்படி வரக்கூடிய துன்பம் எதுவும் இல்லை.
explanation: This couplet emphasizes the power of foresight and prevention. The phrase 'எதிரதாக் காக்கும்' describes the act of anticipating future dangers and taking protective measures before they arrive. Those who possess this active wisdom ('அறிவினார்க்') are never caught off guard. Consequently, no sudden calamity ('நோய்') can ever come to shock or shake ('அதிர') them, as they are always prepared.
